engineers: The refinery increased first-stage displacement rather than replacing the frames. The first-stage liner was bored and the piston changed from 19.5 to 20.5 in.; a restrictive double-deck first-stage suction valve was removed and the valve arrangement revised. The second- and third-stage cylinders, frames and 3,500 hp motors remained. Each compressor then handled 30.9 MMSCFD, 12.4% above the original flow, at about 3,241 bhp. The existing intercoolers were adequate for that increase.
source: Gupta, Starling, Svaan and Higgins, 29th Turbomachinery Symposium (2000), modification and performance sections
note: Withheld from the agent. This is a field compressor rerate; a DWSIM duty check cannot replace cylinder, valve, rod-load or pulsation review.
